title: Communion letters held in the Archives of the Impossible

plain: Thousands of letters that readers sent to the writer Whitley Strieber after his 1987 book Communion, about his own reported meetings with strange visitors, are said to be kept at Rice University in Houston, Texas. Strieber says "four or 5 thousand of them" sit there in a collection called the Archives of the Impossible, which he says was founded by the professor Jeff Kripal. To him, the letters are a record of how many ordinary people say they have had experiences like his.
